description: This file defines the DSNConfigurator class used for configuring PHPMailer instances via DSN strings, including parsing DSN URLs, applying configurations, and setting SMTP options.

classes.name: DSNConfigurator
classes.description: Class responsible for configuring PHPMailer objects using DSN strings, including parsing URLs and setting SMTP options.

methods.name: mailer
methods.description: Creates and configures a new PHPMailer instance based on a DSN string.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures an existing PHPMailer instance with settings derived from a DSN string.

methods.name: parseDSN
methods.description: Parses a DSN string into configuration components, throwing an exception if malformed.

methods.name: applyConfig
methods.description: Applies configuration settings to a PHPMailer object based on parsed DSN data.

methods.name: configureSMTP
methods.description: Sets SMTP-specific options on a PHPMailer object based on DSN data.

methods.name: configureOptions
methods.description: Sets additional options on a PHPMailer object, validating allowed options.

methods.name: parseUrl
methods.description: Wrapper around parse_url to handle PHP version bugs, extracting URL components.
